fields.topology_type: Single-master, multi-slave 2-wire DC bus. One control device (application controller) drives all forward frames; up to 64 short-addressed + 16 group-addressed + broadcast control gear (LED drivers, ballasts, etc.) respond. The bus is wired-AND on the inverted side of the opto-isolators so any transmitter that drives LOW wins, which is what makes the RANDOMIZE/COMPARE/WITHDRAW bisection scheme work during commissioning.

supported_topologies.name: Single DALI universe
supported_topologies.description: One DALI bus power supply + one control device + up to 64 control gear (driver/ballast/emergency-light) + optionally DALI-2 input devices (sensors/buttons). Wiring is 2-wire DC; max cable length ~300 m at 1.5 mm² gauge.

supported_topologies.name: Multi-universe with router
supported_topologies.description: A DALI router / DALI-to-Ethernet gateway bridges multiple DALI universes into a larger building-automation system. Each universe still has its own master + 64-gear limit.

supported_topologies.name: DALI-2 mixed bus
supported_topologies.description: DALI-2 input devices (-301 push button / -302 absolute input / -303 occupancy / -304 light sensor / -305 timer) coexist with control gear on the same bus, distinguished by special-command address patterns.

supported_topologies.name: Mixed device-type bus
supported_topologies.description: DT0 fluorescent + DT6 LED + DT8 colour + DT7 switching gear share the same bus. Device-type-specific extended commands are gated by ENABLE DEVICE TYPE X (special command 0xC1).

supported_topologies.name: Star or daisy-chain wiring
supported_topologies.description: DALI allows any combination of star, bus, and daisy-chain topologies — the only constraint is total cable length / capacitance.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Sole initiator. Builds forward frames, addresses gear, optionally waits for backward frame on queries. May be an embedded panel, BMS gateway, or DALI-to-IP bridge.

master_slave_role_summary.role: Control gear (LED driver / ballast / emergency light / switching gear)
master_slave_role_summary.description: Responds to addressed forward frames; never initiates. May reply with a backward frame on queries.
DALI-2 era addition. Behaves as a control device peer; emits forward frames on its own initiative within an arbitration scheme.

fields.interconnect_role: DALI itself defines no routing or switching. Every transaction is either unicast (short address), multicast (group address), or broadcast on a single bus. Cross-bus routing is delegated to a DALI router / gateway.

ordering_guarantees.within_a_frame: Bits appear in order: start, then address byte MSB→LSB, then data byte MSB→LSB, then stop. Manchester encodes each bit within its bit cell.
ordering_guarantees.across_frames: One forward frame in flight at a time (single master); on a query, the backward frame from one gear is the next bus activity in the 7..22 TE window; the next forward frame waits ≥ 22 TE.
ordering_guarantees.two_strike: Destructive command commit requires two identical deliveries within 100 ms; intervening forward frames break the commit.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: DALI exposes per-gear persistent variables (Power On Level, Min/Max Level, Fade Rate/Time, Short Address, Group bitmaps, Scene 0..15, Random Address, Fast Fade Time, Failure Status, Operating Mode, Dimming Curve) via the indirect command set + DTR mechanism. Optional Memory Banks (bank 0 mandatory per IEC 62386-102; banks 1+ device-type-specific) are accessed via READ/WRITE MEMORY LOCATION + DTR/DTR1/DTR2.

slave_classification.multicast_target: Group address 0..15 — every gear in the group.
slave_classification.configuration_target: Configuration Mode gear (post-INITIALIZE) — addressed via RANDOMIZE + COMPARE / WITHDRAW + SEARCH ADDRESS H/M/L.

broadcast_topology.valid_commands: All direct-level commands; almost all indirect commands except queries.
broadcast_topology.queries_disallowed: Broadcast queries would cause every gear to drive the backward window simultaneously — bus collision.
broadcast_topology.gear_action: Every gear receives and applies; no backward frame.

gateway_routing_topology.front_end: DALI 2-wire bus on the gear side.
gateway_routing_topology.back_end: Application protocol — KNX, BACnet, Modbus TCP, MQTT, REST API on the BMS side.
gateway_routing_topology.addressing: Gateway maintains a per-universe map of short addresses + group memberships and translates BMS-side identifiers to DALI forward frames.
gateway_routing_topology.failure_modes: Gateway loses upstream → DALI bus continues to operate with default Power On Level / System Failure Level; gateway loses downstream → BMS sees stale telemetry.
